path.data-text: The first medicine reminder designed to be needed less.
The same moment, after breakfast, as the habit grows. The ink on the screen is the habit.
Day 38: a miss, so the reminder grows back
Habit strength = share of doses opened before any cue, last 14 days
A slip brings full reminders back at once
Day 60 at rest: almost blank paper
Help only at the right moment (JITAI, 2018).
So Lyra gets quieter as you get better.
